response:
Honestly, I lean more toward empirical evidence and data. Intuition and philosophical reasoning are useful for generating hypotheses and framing questions, but when I actually need to form a stable opinion I want something I can check, test, and update. Data keeps me honest and stops me from getting too attached to a neat story that feels right.

That said, I don't trust raw data without interpretation, so I still lean on philosophical reasoning to decide what to measure and why it matters. It's a data-first, sense-making-second combo for me.
